security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:1420 ws://127.0.0.1:1420; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A small desktop robot for starting and finding your AI chats and projects.
bundle.longDescription: Orbit is a local desktop companion that opens Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Claude Code with your own subscriptions, keeps saved conversation links searchable, and reopens project folders. It never asks for API keys.
